name: Ichimoku
summary: This EA trades based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicator system, using the interaction of the Tenkan-sen, Kijun-sen, Senkou Span A, and Senkou Span B to identify trend direction and generate entry signals. It enters long positions when price is above the cloud and the Tenkan-sen crosses above the Kijun-sen, and enters short positions under the opposite conditions. The EA manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels derived from the Ichimoku components.
summary_zh: 该EA基于一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）指标系统进行交易，利用转换线、基准线、先行带A和先行带B的相互关系来判断趋势方向并生成入场信号。当价格位于云层上方且转换线上穿基准线时做多，在相反条件下做空。EA通过基于一目均衡表组件的可配置止损和止盈水平来管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于一目均衡表（Ichimoku Kinko Hyo）这一经典的日本技术分析系统。入场条件为：做多时要求价格位于云层（Kumo）上方，且Tenkan-sen（转换线）向上穿越Kijun-sen（基准线），形成看涨交叉；做空时要求价格位于云层下方，且Tenkan-sen向下穿越Kijun-sen，形成看跌交叉。云层的颜色和厚度也被用作趋势强度和支撑阻力的判断依据。出场条件包括止损和止盈的设定，通常止损设于云层的另一侧，止盈则基于风险回报比或Chikou Span（迟行线）的确认。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比进行计算，允许用户自定义交易量。资金管理方面，EA提供可配置的止损距离和最大持仓限制，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制如ATR-based止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Ichimoku Kinko Hyo system, a classic Japanese technical analysis framework. Entry conditions require price to be above the Kumo (cloud) with the Tenkan-sen crossing above the Kijun-sen for long positions, and price below the cloud with the Tenkan-sen crossing below the Kijun-sen for short positions. The cloud's color and thickness serve as additional confirmations for trend strength and support/resistance levels. Exit conditions include stop loss placement typically on the opposite side of the cloud and take profit based on risk-reward ratios or Chikou Span confirmation. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach or percentage-of-balance method with user-configurable trade volume. Money management provides configurable stop loss distances and maximum position limits, but lacks dynamic position sizing mechanisms such as ATR-based stops or volatility-adjusted lot calculations.

parameters.name: InpStopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示使用云层止损

parameters.name: InpTakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

parameters.name: InpMagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号码，用于区分订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for distinguishing orders

pros: 一目均衡表是成熟的趋势跟踪系统，同时提供趋势方向、支撑阻力和动量信息
云层（Kumo）作为动态支撑阻力区域，相比固定止损更具市场适应性
多维度确认（价格位置+线交叉+云层颜色）减少了虚假信号的产生
参数标准化（9/26/52）经过长期市场验证，减少了过度优化的风险
策略逻辑清晰透明，易于理解和调试
pros_en: Ichimoku is a well-established trend following system providing trend direction, support/resistance, and momentum simultaneously
The Kumo cloud acts as a dynamic support/resistance zone, offering better market adaptability than fixed stops
Multi-dimensional confirmation (price position + line crossover + cloud color) reduces false signals
Standardized parameters (9/26/52) are time-tested in markets, reducing overfitting risk
Clear and transparent strategy logic that is easy to understand and debug
cons: 在震荡市场中表现不佳，云层频繁变色会产生大量虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏动态止损机制（如ATR止损），固定点数止损在不同波动率环境下效果差异大
未包含新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在高点差环境下入场成本可能过高
资金管理较为简单，未采用基于波动率的动态仓位调整
cons_en: Performs poorly in ranging markets as frequent cloud color changes generate numerous false signals leading to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic stop loss mechanisms (e.g., ATR-based stops), making fixed-pip stops ineffective across varying volatility environments
Missing new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same candle
No spread filter, meaning entry costs may be excessive in high-spread environments
Money management is simplistic without volatility-based dynamic position sizing
improvements: 添加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡市中暂停交易以避免虚假信号
实现基于ATR的动态止损和仓位管理，提高对不同市场环境的适应性
增加新K线检查和点差过滤，防止重复开仓和高成本入场
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to pause trading during ranging markets and avoid false signals
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop loss and position sizing to improve adaptability across different market conditions
Add new bar check and spread filter to prevent duplicate entries and high-cost entries

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一K线上重复开仓导致过度持仓
固定止损在不同波动率环境下可能过紧或过松，导致不必要的亏损或风险暴露过大
震荡市中频繁的虚假信号可能导致连续小额亏损积累成大额亏损
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check may cause duplicate position openings on the same candle leading to overexposure
Fixed stop loss may be too tight or too loose across varying volatility, causing unnecessary losses or excessive risk exposure
Frequent false signals in ranging markets may lead to accumulated small losses becoming significant drawdowns
